## Indexing and data transformations

```{r}
set.seed(123)
age <- sample(1:90, size = 10, replace = TRUE)
age[age == 14]
age[age > 60 | age <18]
age[age == 18 | age >18 & age <65 | age == 65]
age[age >= 18 & age <= 65]

##Altermative
idx <- age > 60| age <18
age[idx]

##To check the presence of one vector in another
A <- seq(1, 12, 2)  # odd numbers
B <- seq(2, 12, 2)  # even numbers

# test to see if each of the elements of A is in B  
A %in% B

## Another example
epi <- str_split_1("epidemiology", "")
epi
epi <- str_split_1("epidemiology", "")
epi
epi[are_vowels]
```

```{r}
## Useful fucntions on vectors
##sort and order
v <- runif(5, min=1, max=10)
sort(v)
order(v)
```

```{r}
w <- c(6.1, 8.9, NA, 5.0, 8.8, 1.9, 6.6, 7.2, 9.4, NA, 4.9)

mean(w)
mean(w, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
##Day2 exercises
set.seed(123)
score <- runif(10, min=1, max=20)
score
length(score)
any(score < 6)
idx <- score < 6
score[idx]
score[score >7 & score <9]
cum_score <- sum(score)
length(cum_score)
test <- c(9, NA, 5, 2, NA, 4)
mean(test, na.rm = TRUE)
```
